style: Crude clumsy MS Paint doodle drawn by someone with no drawing skill, deliberately rough and funny. Plain white background. Thick uneven wobbly black marker outlines. Stick figures with round heads, dot eyes, simple line mouths, straight stick limbs. Every stick figure has exactly one head, two arms and two legs, and every line is connected to the body. Flat solid color fills only, no shading, no gradients, no texture, no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no writing anywhere. Vertical portrait composition.
rurik: a small pink hairless sphynx doodle cat with huge ears (Rurik)
